MtPyre_1F_Text_TakeThisForYourOwnGood:
All sorts of beings wander the slopes of MT. PYRE…
There is no telling what may happen. Take this. It's for your own good.
MtPyre_1F_Text_ExplainCleanseTag:
Have a POKéMON hold that CLEANSE TAG.
It will help ward off wild POKéMON.
MtPyre_1F_Text_ComeToPayRespects:
Did you come to pay your respect to the spirits of departed POKéMON?
You must care for your POKéMON a lot.
MtPyre_1F_Text_RestingPlaceOfZigzagoon: This is the final resting place of my ZIGZAGOON. I cherished it…
